articles.summary: AmeriServ Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASRV) reported third quarter 2026 net income of $3,100,000, or $0.18 per diluted common share. This earnings performance represented a $556,000, or 21.9%, improvement from the third quarter of 2025 when net income totaled $2,544,000, or $0.15 per diluted common share. For the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, the Company reported net income of $7,632,000, or $0.45 per diluted common share. This represented an 80.0% increase in earnings per share from the nine-month period of 2025 when net income totaled $4,170,000, or $0.25 per diluted common share. articles.summary: AmeriServ Bank has transitioned its investment services program to the Ameriprise Financial Institution Group (AFIG). The bank is headquartered in Johnstown, Pennsylvania. AmeriServ's financial advisors help clients manage approximately $525 million in assets across the state of Pennsylvania and Western Maryland. Through Ameriprise Financial, AmeriServ Bank clients will have access to a full range of leading services and solutions including: Personalized advice and financial planning capabilities tailored to their individual needs. Robust investment products to help them achieve their financial goals with more confidence. Digital capabilities that allow clients to connect with their advisors where and how they want—face-to-face, online, video or phone meetings. AmeriServ Board of Directors Chairman J.
